name: Momentis Surgical
description: Momentis Surgical (formerly Memic Innovative Surgery) is a medical robotics company founded in 2013 in Or Yehuda (Tel Aviv), Israel, with U.S. headquarters in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. The company develops the [Anovo](/robot/momentis_anovo) surgical system featuring miniature humanoid-articulated arms for transvaginal and minimally invasive gynecological procedures.
